terms.title: AI content terms
terms.generatedBody:
This app uses AI to write replies. Content marked as generated by AI comes from models and should be checked.

AI-written content may contain errors. Always check important information.
terms.intro: AI-written content may contain errors. Always check important information.
terms.generatedDetail: This app uses AI to write replies. All content marked as generated by AI comes from models and should be checked for accuracy.
terms.disclaimersBody:
• AI-written content may contain errors
• Replies are based on training data and may not reflect current events
• Do not rely on AI content for medical, legal, or financial advice
• Always check important information with a trusted source
terms.safetyBody:
• Models are built to refuse harmful requests
• Filters may not catch every harmful reply
• You are responsible for how you use AI features
